\section{An included chapter}
This text comes from a separate source file. A finite transport problem has the form
\begin{equation}\label{eq:transport}
\min_{\pi_{ij}\ge0}\sum_{i,j}c_{ij}\pi_{ij},
\qquad \sum_j\pi_{ij}=\mu_i,\qquad\sum_i\pi_{ij}=\nu_j.
\end{equation}
Equation~\eqref{eq:transport} contains both the objective and marginal constraints.
An unnumbered formula remains unnumbered:
\begin{equation*}
\sum_i\mu_i=\sum_j\nu_j=1.
\end{equation*}
